tweaks.defaultDescription: Unset: Claude Code picks the renderer.
tweaks.title: Renderer
tweaks.description: Choose the classic screen or the flicker-free fullscreen screen.
tweaks.notes: The env vars CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN and CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=0 force the classic screen and beat this setting.

tweaks.defaultDescription: Unset: the verbose setting and your last /focus choice apply.
tweaks.title: Starting view
tweaks.description: Choose how much of the transcript new sessions show.

requires.reason: Focus view needs the fullscreen renderer.

tweaks.notes: Overrides the verbose setting and the sticky /focus choice. Focus view needs the fullscreen renderer.

tweaks.defaultDescription: false: thinking shows as a collapsed stub.
tweaks.title: Show thinking summaries
tweaks.description: Show full thinking summaries when you expand thinking with Ctrl+O.
tweaks.notes: Display only. Thinking tokens are billed either way.

tweaks.defaultDescription: false: the option is not shown.
tweaks.title: Clear context on plan accept
tweaks.description: Add a clear context and implement option to the plan approval menu.
tweaks.notes: Clearing context drops the conversation, so only the plan carries over.

tweaks.title: Plans folder
tweaks.description: Choose the folder where plan mode saves plan files.
tweaks.notes: The path is relative to the project root. Claude Code keeps the default when the path resolves outside the project.

suggestions.label: Proactive
suggestions.note: Starts work right away and makes reasonable assumptions about routine decisions.

suggestions.label: Concise
suggestions.note: Leads with the result and leaves out preamble, narration and recaps. Needs v2.1.237 or later.

suggestions.label: Explanatory
suggestions.note: Adds short Insight blocks that explain the choices behind the code.

suggestions.label: Learning
suggestions.note: Explains its choices and leaves small pieces of code for you to write.

tweaks.title: Output style
tweaks.description: Set the output style by name, such as Explanatory or Learning.
tweaks.notes: Names are case-sensitive: explanatory gives the default style. Built-in names are Proactive, Concise, Explanatory and Learning. Custom style names are allowed, so this row is a string.

tweaks.title: Color theme
tweaks.description: Choose the color theme.
tweaks.notes: Custom themes (custom:<slug>) are valid in Claude Code but are not offered here.

tweaks.title: Prompt key bindings
tweaks.description: Use normal or vim key bindings in the prompt box.
tweaks.notes: Vim mode has NORMAL, INSERT and VISUAL modes.

tweaks.title: Show turn duration
tweaks.description: Show how long each reply took.
tweaks.notes: Display only.

tweaks.title: Spinner tips
tweaks.description: Show tips under the spinner while Claude works.
tweaks.notes: Display only.

tweaks.title: Reduce motion
tweaks.description: Reduce or turn off animations such as the spinner and shimmer.
tweaks.notes: Display only.

tweaks.title: Prompt suggestions
tweaks.description: Show grayed-out prompt suggestions in the prompt box.
tweaks.notes: Display only. Needs a claude.ai or Console account with telemetry on, so it has no effect while DISABLE_TELEMETRY is set.

tweaks.defaultDescription: auto: desktop notification in iTerm2, Ghostty and Kitty; a bell in Terminal.app only if its audible bell is off; nothing elsewhere.
tweaks.title: Notification channel
tweaks.description: Choose how Claude Code tells you a task is done or waiting.
tweaks.notes: Older Claude Code versions keep this value in ~/.claude.json.

tweaks.defaultDescription: never: the dialog waits for you.
tweaks.title: Question timeout
tweaks.description: Continue on its own when a question dialog stays unanswered.
tweaks.notes: Only honored in user or managed settings. Claude continues without your answer after the timeout.

tweaks.title: Recap after being away
tweaks.description: Show a one-line recap when you come back after a few minutes.
tweaks.notes: Display only.

suggestions.label: Best
suggestions.note: Fable where it is available to you, otherwise the same model as opus.

suggestions.label: Fable
suggestions.note: The Fable model for your provider, for your hardest and longest-running tasks.

suggestions.label: Opus
suggestions.note: The latest Opus model, for complex reasoning tasks.

suggestions.label: Sonnet
suggestions.note: The latest Sonnet model, for daily coding tasks.

suggestions.label: Haiku
suggestions.note: The fast and efficient Haiku model, for simple tasks.

suggestions.label: Opus plan
suggestions.note: Opus in plan mode, then Sonnet for execution. The /model picker does not list it; /model opusplan saves it to user settings (tested 2026-10-06).

suggestions.label: Opus, 1M context
suggestions.note: Opus with a 1 million token context window.

suggestions.label: Sonnet, 1M context
suggestions.note: Sonnet with a 1 million token context window. No effect when sonnet already resolves to a model with a native 1M window.

suggestions.label: Fable, 1M context
suggestions.note: The 1M context form of the fable alias.

suggestions.label: Opus plan, 1M context
suggestions.note: opusplan with 1M context in both phases where the models do not already run with it.

tweaks.title: Default model
tweaks.description: Set the model new sessions use, as an alias or a full model ID.
tweaks.notes: Suggestions are the aliases on the model configuration page. Full model names such as claude-opus-5-5 are also valid, and pin a version. The docs call default a special value that clears any model override, so it is not offered as a suggestion. ANTHROPIC_MODEL in env and the --model flag both beat this key. Pitot can only see the env one.

tweaks.title: Effort cap
tweaks.description: Set the highest reasoning effort Claude may use.
tweaks.notes: The lowest cap across all settings files wins.

tweaks.defaultDescription: Unset: thinking is on for models that support it.
tweaks.title: Always think
tweaks.description: Set false to turn extended thinking off for every session.
tweaks.notes: False has no effect on models that always think, such as Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Fable.

tweaks.title: Fast mode
tweaks.description: Start sessions in fast mode where it is available.
tweaks.notes: Fast mode costs more per token.

tweaks.defaultDescription: Unset: each request gets its default lifetime.
tweaks.title: Prompt cache lifetime
tweaks.description: Set how long the prompt cache holds for the main conversation.
tweaks.notes: The 1 hour cache costs more per cache write.

tweaks.title: Auto-compact
tweaks.description: Compact the conversation automatically when context nears the limit.
tweaks.notes: Turning it off can fill the context window and stop a long session.

tweaks.defaultDescription: Unset: subagents follow their own settings.
tweaks.title: Subagent model
tweaks.description: Set the default model for subagents, teammates and workflow agents.
tweaks.notes: Accepts an alias or a full model name. An alias here always resolves to the version it points to. inherit is the same as unset. Does not beat a model Claude passes at spawn or a model set in the agent definition.

tweaks.defaultDescription: Unset: the subagent model is only a default.
tweaks.title: Force one subagent model
tweaks.description: Make every subagent use one model. With CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL set, that model. Without it, the main conversation's model.
tweaks.notes: Works on its own. Agent definitions and the model Claude passes at spawn are ignored. When only this is set, the built-in Explore subagent keeps the model listed for it.

tweaks.title: Block claude.ai connectors
tweaks.description: Stop Claude Code from fetching and connecting claude.ai MCP connectors.
tweaks.notes: True in any settings file applies. A project false cannot override a user true. Explicit --mcp-config servers are not affected.

tweaks.title: Disable telemetry
tweaks.description: Opt out of telemetry.

confirm.message: This also stops feature-flag fetching, so features that need it stop working. Prompt suggestions stop too.

tweaks.notes: Any non-empty value turns it on, even 0. Pitot removes the key to turn it off. Features that need feature-flag fetching stop, such as the advisor, /import, artifact comments and skill sync. promptSuggestionEnabled has no effect while telemetry is off. Remote Control stays available unless your organization requires Trusted Devices (v2.1.283 or later).

tweaks.title: Disable error reporting
tweaks.description: Opt out of error reporting.
tweaks.notes: Any non-empty value turns it on, even 0. Pitot removes the key to turn it off.

tweaks.defaultDescription: Unset: the tool follows your account's availability.
tweaks.title: Artifact tool
tweaks.description: Set false to turn the Artifact tool off for every session.
tweaks.notes: False in any settings file applies. True is the same as unset.

tweaks.defaultDescription: Unset: /init writes a CLAUDE.md without asking.
tweaks.title: Interactive /init
tweaks.description: Make /init ask which files to generate before it writes them.
tweaks.notes: The docs say to set it to 1. It also lets /init create CLAUDE.local.md.

tweaks.defaultDescription: false: Bash commands run without a sandbox.
tweaks.title: Sandbox shell commands
tweaks.description: Run Bash commands inside the sandbox.

confirm.message: With the sandbox off, Bash commands run with your full user access. They can read files such as ~/.ssh and ~/.aws, write anywhere and reach any host. Permission prompts still apply. The sandbox is off by default.

tweaks.notes: Related sandbox settings are not in this catalog yet.

tweaks.defaultDescription: Unset: reads outside follow your permission mode.
tweaks.title: Block reads outside the project
tweaks.description: Refuse file reads outside the working directories in every mode.

confirm.message: Claude's file tools will be able to read outside the working directories again, as your permission mode allows. A true in another settings file still applies.

tweaks.notes: Protective. True in any file applies, and a repo cannot lift it.

tweaks.title: Forbid bypass mode
tweaks.description: Turn on to block bypassPermissions mode. Pitot writes the string disable.

confirm.message: Bypass permissions mode becomes available again, unless another settings file still disables it. In that mode Claude runs almost anything without asking.

tweaks.notes: Protective. The only valid value is the string disable. A user can lock themselves out.

tweaks.title: Starting permission mode
tweaks.description: Choose the permission mode new sessions start in.

confirm.message: Bypass mode lets Claude run almost anything without asking.

tweaks.notes: Settings reference: "auto and bypassPermissions don't take effect from project or local settings, so set them in ~/.claude/settings.json instead." Pitot writes those two values only to user settings. bypassPermissions skips almost all prompts. The docs also accept manual as an alias for default. Pitot does not offer it.

tweaks.title: API base URL
tweaks.description: Send API requests to another host, such as a proxy or gateway.

confirm.message: This sends all your prompts and code to that host.

tweaks.notes: Remote Control is disabled for a non-Anthropic host. Telemetry is still sent. Do not put keys in env.
